# NodeStack

> NodeStack is a digital product and web development agency building modern websites, scalable platforms, Web3 products, AI integrations, and hospitality booking experiences for businesses in Romania and Europe.

Canonical website: https://www.nodestack.pro/
Primary language: Romanian
Additional languages: English, German, Norwegian

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.nodestack.pro/): Company overview, core technologies, services, and featured projects.
- [Business websites](https://www.nodestack.pro/services/websites): Responsive business websites, domain setup, Cloudflare, SEO, Google Business, analytics, maintenance, and support.
- [Hospitality websites](https://www.nodestack.pro/services/hospitality): Websites for hotels, villas, and guesthouses with rooms, galleries, amenities, reviews, local attractions, direct WhatsApp booking, payments, and booking-platform integrations.
- [SEO services](https://www.nodestack.pro/services/seo): Technical and local SEO audits, Core Web Vitals, keyword research, on-page optimization, Google Business, Search Console, indexing, and reporting.
- [Web applications](https://www.nodestack.pro/services/web-applications): Full-stack platforms, dashboards, automation, AI integrations, REST APIs, authentication, payments, subscriptions, and Web3 systems.
- [Portfolio](https://www.nodestack.pro/portfolio): Selected NodeStack projects.
- [Contact](https://www.nodestack.pro/contact): Contact NodeStack about a new project.

## Selected work

- [RoVista](https://rovista.ro/): Independent bilingual travel guide and web application for discovering Romania through curated attractions, regions, practical context, and saved places.
- [Hospitality Booking Demo](https://www.nodestack.pro/demos/hospitality): Customizable hotel and villa website demo with accommodation details, galleries, reviews, attractions, and direct WhatsApp booking.
- [ProArt Studio](https://proartstudio.ro/): Responsive presentation website for a recording studio.
- [Fusemon](https://www.fusemon.fun/): Competitive Solana trading card game with collectible cards, marketplace activity, and PvP battles.
- [4Chad](https://4chad.xyz/): Solana token launchpad and trading platform.
- [SpinSaga](https://spinsaga.fun/): Gamified Solana utility product for NFT collections.
- [Jah Order Sound System](https://jah-order.vercel.app/): Responsive web application focused on a straightforward user flow.

## Crawling

Public pages may be indexed. Administrative and generated preview routes are not intended for indexing. The sitemap is available at https://www.nodestack.pro/sitemap.xml.
